mission.title: Police Escort
mission.description: Investigate reported sightings of the Zionite Mauser alongside the city police.

npc.say: Hey, hit the road, Sherlock! I got enough to do without you sniffing around my crime scene.
Jesus, I need to wash this helmet.
I think we can handle this. Why don't you go shuffle some papers around in your big fancy office?
Nothing's getting in or out of here, sir.
What do you think we're dealing with here, sir? Why would they break in but not take any money? Is it serial cyber crime, like they're saying down at the station?
*Retire in ten days... I don't need this terrorist bullcrap...*
Shouldn't you do something about the...you know...body?
Gotta have good shoes for this kind of thing.
That little program I wrote should be keeping them pretty busy back at HQ!

phase.briefing:
Information intercepted from Zion over the past week indicates that they believe their crewman "Mauser" has been entering the Matrix, despite his lack of the usual interface jacks, and their previous belief that he was killed on the surface shortly after the fall of Zion.
While this information is dubious, city law enforcement has received a number of reports of a man matching Mauser's description. Obviously, if this is in fact Mauser, we would like to know how he has been able to jack in to the simulation.
You are assigned to investigate one of these reports now. A special weapons unit has already secured the scene.

enter.say: Looks like we missed the action.

talk.say:
You're who now? I'm gonna need to see some credentials. ...
*Sonova feds crawlin' up my--* Gilbert! Get your ass over here!
Look...{player}...we got this place covered. Now, Gilbert here thinks they may've spotted the perp on their beat. So why don't you just go take a jog with them and see what you two can turn up? Awright, get lost, Gilbert.
Hey, hit the road, Sherlock! I got enough to do without you sniffing around my crime scene.

Great, let's go!
Yeah, I'm sure I spotted this guy. Tall, bald, dark skin, looking like a terrorist... No two ways about it, it must've been him!

objective.text: Lead Officer Gilbert out of the area

phase.briefing: Work with the local officials as necessary, operative.

enter.say:
Man, life on the beat sucks.
That should be their HQ. You can drop them off there.

objective.text: Escort Officer Gilbert to the end of their beat

done.say: Okay... Can we call Gray and get on with this, please?

near.say: Hm... It was right around here somewhere that I saw him... I think... Or maybe down there...

phase.briefing: Yes, we have another report matching the same description. Local officials have yet to reach the scene.

enter.say: Right, I've got one signal in there...probably a civilian. Some kind of computer system, too.

talk.say:
God, I don't know! I found them like that. Of course I called you right away! The operator said to leave the apartment, but what if *he's* waiting outside?
Did you see anyone? There was a strange man going out of the building as I came in. I've never seen him here before--he certainly doesn't live here! Oh, but I told all that to the operator.

done.say:
I scanned some prints off that keyboard. I'll send them to Gray.
Hrm... Activity log's been wiped. Great.

phase.briefing: The fingerprints you found match partial prints retrieved by police at the previous location. We've correlated them with another incident reported recently. The reporting officials have...assured me that the data record at this site has been left undisturbed.

enter.say: That's the spot. The officials have been notified to let you through.

talk.say: Yes, this is the system that was tampered with. It looks like there was an attempt to delete activity records, but they were restored automatically from our backup server.

objective.text: Get the log file from the computer
Upload the log file at a hardline

near.say: Finally, solid data! Get the information and upload it at the nearest hardline.

mission.finish:
Analysis of surveillance data from areas around the crime scenes has yielded minimal additional information on the individual; he is not travelling by standard means.
The log file you returned from the hacked terminal shows connection to a remote system via network tunneling. The connection protocol is both unfamiliar and encrypted; we are unable to determine what he connected to, and what intercommunication may have taken place.
This case is presenting unusual challenges. The individual's techniques could be dangerous if made available to Zion as a whole. I have raised the priority of the target, temporary designation "Mauser." Your contribution today has been appreciated, {player}.
